people.name: Alexandru Averescu
people.nameZh: 亞歷山德魯·阿維雷斯庫

heading.en: Origins, enlistment and early military posts

body.zh-Hant: 《義大利百科全書》（1930年，奧斯卡·蘭迪撰）記載，亞歷山德魯·阿維雷斯庫生於1859年4月22日，出生地在多瑙河畔的伊斯梅爾，家庭務農。他1876年3月以士兵身分加入羅馬尼亞軍隊，1883至1886年由國家出資送往都靈的軍事學院，1895至1898年任駐柏林公使館武官，1906年晉升准將。
body.en: According to the Enciclopedia Italiana (1930, by Oscar Randi), Alexandru Averescu was born on 22 April 1859 at Ismail on the Danube into a farming family. He enlisted in the Romanian army as a soldier in March 1876, was sent at state expense to the Turin academy in 1883–1886, served as military attaché at the Berlin legation in 1895–1898, and was promoted brigadier general in 1906.

citations.quote: Ismail sul Danubio (al confine meridionale della Bessarabia) il 22 aprile 1859
nato da famiglia di agricoltori al Ismail
Nel marzo 1876 si arrolò nell'esercito
fu mandato, a spese dello stato, all'accademia di Torino (1883-1886)
fu dal 1895 al 1898 addetto militare alla legazione di Berlino
Nel 1906 fu promosso generale di brigata

heading.en: War minister and chief of the general staff

body.zh-Hant: 同一條目寫道，他在迪米特里·斯圖爾扎內閣擔任陸軍部長（1907至1909年）。1911年他獲任命為總參謀長，1912年晉升師長級將軍，並指揮羅馬尼亞軍隊投入1913年對保加利亞的短期戰役。
body.en: The same entry says he served as minister of war in Dimitrie Sturdza's cabinet (1907–1909). In 1911 he was appointed chief of the general staff, in 1912 he was promoted divisional general, and he directed the Romanian army's operations in the brief 1913 campaign against Bulgaria.

citations.quote: quale ministro della guerra, nel gabinetto di Demetrio Sturdza (1907-1909)
Nel 1911 ebbe la nomina a capo dello Stato maggiore
promosso, nel 1912, generale di divisione
diresse le operazioni dell'esercito romeno nella breve campagna del 1913

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰與1918年組閣
heading.en: The First World War and the 1918 government

body.zh-Hant: 大戰爆發時他指揮克拉約瓦的第一軍，其後依序接掌第二軍團、第三軍團與南方集團軍群。他的名字與1916年10月的弗勒芒達行動、1917年7月的馬拉謝什蒂戰役相連，1917年晉升軍長級將軍。他與總理布勒蒂亞努衝突；後者1918年2月被迫下台後，國王斐迪南委他組閣，他於1918年3月5日在布夫泰簽署和平預備條款。
body.en: When the war began he commanded the I Army Corps at Craiova, then took over the Second Army, the Third, and finally the southern army group. His name is tied to the Flămânda operation of October 1916 and the battle of Mărăşeşti in July 1917, and in 1917 he was promoted army corps general. He clashed with prime minister Brătianu; after Brătianu was forced out in February 1918 King Ferdinand entrusted him with forming a new ministry, and he signed the preliminary peace at Buftea on 5 March 1918.

citations.quote: che aveva il comando del I corpo d'armata di Craiova
assunse quello della II armata, poi della III, indi del gruppo d'armate del sud
operazione di Flămânda (ottobre 1916)

Nel 1917 fu promosso generale di corpo d'armata

Quando questi fu costretto a ritirarsi nel febbraio 1918

heading.en: The People's Party and the 1920–1921 government

body.zh-Hant: 戰後他離開軍隊專心從政，組織人民黨，與布勒蒂亞努家族領導的自由黨對立。1919年組成以瓦伊達-沃埃沃德為首的聯合內閣，他出任內政部長。該內閣倒台後，他1920年第二度出任內閣總理；索拉的論文給出任期為1920年3月13日至1921年12月16日，並列他1920年3月13日至6月13日為內政部長。1921年12月，外交部長塔凱·約內斯庫率國民民主派分裂，使內閣垮台。
body.en: After the war he left the army to devote himself to politics and organised the People's Party, which developed in opposition to the Liberals led by the Brătianu family. A concentration ministry under Vaida-Voevod was formed in 1919 and he took the Interior portfolio. After that ministry fell he was called in 1920 to preside over the Council for the second time; Sora's article gives the term as 13 March 1920 to 16 December 1921 and lists him as Minister of the Interior from 13 March to 13 June 1920. In December 1921 his foreign minister Take Ionescu brought the cabinet down through a secession of the National Democrats.

citations.quote: l'A. si congedò dall'esercito per dedicarsi tutto alla politica
organizzò un nuovo partito, il partito del popolo (poporului)
si sviluppò in antagonismo a quello liberale guidato dai Bratianu

fu chiamato, nel 1920, per la seconda volta alla presidenza del Consiglio

heading.zh-Hant: 在野與1926至1927年第三次組閣
heading.en: Opposition and the third government of 1926–1927

body.zh-Hant: 1922年選舉中人民黨在眾議院只取得10個議席，他轉入反對自由黨的陣營。1926年4月初，國王斐迪南的信任使他第三度出任內閣總理，且不兼任部長；他促成義大利批准比薩拉比亞併入的議定書。索拉的論文記此屆任期為1926年3月30日至1927年6月4日，義大利百科則寫他1927年6月初因約內爾·布勒蒂亞努的反對而辭職。
body.en: In the 1922 elections the People's Party won only 10 seats in the Chamber and he went into opposition to the Liberals. At the beginning of April 1926 King Ferdinand's confidence called him back for a third time as head of government, as president of the Council without portfolio; he obtained Italy's ratification of the protocol on the annexation of Bessarabia. Sora's article dates this term 30 March 1926 to 4 June 1927, while the Enciclopedia Italiana says he resigned in early June 1927 because of the opposition of Ionel Brătianu.

citations.quote: il partito del popolo raccolse 10 soli mandati alla Camera
L'A. passò all'opposizione contro i liberali
per la terza volta, a capo del Governo, ai primi d'aprile 1926
Quale presidente del Consiglio, senza portafoglio
ottenere dall'Italia la ratifica del protocollo di annessione della Bessarabia

people.name: José Félix Uriburu
people.nameZh: 何塞·費利克斯·烏里布魯

heading.en: Birth, military school and early posts

body.zh-Hant: 據《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》（維森特·帕萊爾莫撰），何塞·費利克斯·烏里布魯生於1868年7月20日的薩爾塔，畢業於國立軍事學院。他自1907年起出任高等戰爭學校校長，並兩度被派往歐洲擔任武官。1913年他當選薩爾塔省的全國眾議員，任至1914年。
body.en: According to the Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture (by Vicente Palermo), José Félix Uriburu was born on 20 July 1868 in Salta and graduated from the Colegio Militar de la Nación. He directed the Higher School of War from 1907 and was twice sent to Europe as a military attaché. In 1913 he was elected national deputy for the province of Salta and served until 1914.

citations.quote: He was born on July 20, 1868, in Salta
graduated from the Colegio Militar de la Nación
served as director of the Higher School of War beginning in 1907
sent twice to Europe as a military attaché
In 1913 he was elected national deputy for the province of Salta
province of Salta and served until 1914

heading.en: Major general and army inspector general

body.zh-Hant: 百科記載他1921年晉升少將，並稱從1922年起出任陸軍總監。桑切斯的論文則寫他1923年接掌新設的陸軍總監部，1926年因請求遭拒、預算被削減而離職；兩份來源對起年不同。
body.en: The encyclopedia records that he was promoted major general in 1921 and that from 1922 he was appointed inspector general of the army. Sánchez's article instead says he took charge of the newly created Inspección General in 1923 and left the post in 1926, annoyed by refusals of his requests and budget cuts; the two sources differ on the starting year.

citations.quote: In 1921 he was promoted to major general.
From 1922, having been appointed inspector general of the army
se hizo cargo en 1923 de la creada
En 1926 abandona el cargo, fastidiado por las negativas a sus pedidos
recortes presupuestarios impuestos desde el ministerio de Guerra

heading.en: The 1930 coup and the provisional government

body.zh-Hant: 百科記載他指揮1930年9月6日的軍民聯合政變，推翻總統伊里戈延；最高法院承認他為總統，他解散國會並宣布戒嚴。桑切斯的論文稱這個事實上的政府延續了十七個月；1931年6月18日烏里布魯公布憲法改革宣言。
body.en: The encyclopedia says he commanded the military-civilian coup of 6 September 1930 that deposed Irigoyen; the supreme court acknowledged him as president, he dissolved congress and declared a state of siege. Sánchez's article calls it a de facto government that lasted seventeen months, and on 18 June 1931 Uriburu made public the manifesto on constitutional reform.

citations.quote: commanded the September 6, 1930, military-civilian coup that deposed Irigoyen
The supreme court acknowledged him as president, dissolved the congress,
and declared a state of siege
fue un gobierno de facto que se extendió por diecisiete meses
el 18 de junio de 1931 el general Uriburu dio a conocer el maniﬁesto

heading.zh-Hant: 政變的組織與支持力量
heading.en: Organisation and backing of the coup

body.zh-Hant: 桑切斯的論文指出，烏里布魯將軍要成功奪權，首先得取得武裝部隊（主要是陸軍）廣泛的支持；愛國聯盟與公民軍團等受政府容忍的準警察組織，則很早就熱情協助政變。同一論文又寫到，原定計畫所依賴的部隊並未起事，計畫因此改為「軍事學院與民眾支持」，凸顯行動的倉促與臨場應變。
body.en: Sánchez's article states that for General Uriburu to succeed he first needed the broad backing of the armed forces, chiefly the army, while parapolice groups tolerated by the government such as the Liga Patriótica Argentina and the Legión Cívica gave early and enthusiastic support to the coup. It adds that the forces on which the original plan relied had not risen, so the plan was recast as 'Colegio Militar and popular support', showing the improvisation of the action.

citations.quote: debía contar primeramente con el apoyo extensivo de las fuerzas armadas
(principalmente del Ejército)
Liga Patriótica Argentina y La Legión Cívica
organizaciones parapoliciales (toleradas por el gobierno)
prestaron tempranamente su colaboración y apoyo entusiasta a la causa golpista
no se habían sublevado
el nuevo plan se denominaría “Colegio Militar y apoyo popular”
gran nivel de improvisación y premura

body.zh-Hant: 1932年2月20日，群眾上街陪同這位卸任的臨時總統從政府大樓走回住處；據百科，阿古斯丁·胡斯托此後在舞弊的選舉中就任總統。德國國家圖書館權威檔記他於1932年4月29日在巴黎去世。
body.en: On 20 February 1932 a crowd took to the streets to accompany the outgoing provisional president from the government house to his home; according to the encyclopedia, General Agustín P. Justo then assumed the presidency in fraudulent elections. The German National Library authority record gives his death as 29 April 1932 in Paris.

citations.quote: El 20 de febrero de 1932, una multitud salió a las calles
acompañar al exmandatario en el trayecto de la casa de gobierno a su hogar
In 1932, in fraudulent elections, General Agustín P. Justo assumed
"label" : "Paris"

body.zh-Hant: 魯賓薩爾的論文記載，卸任後的前臨時總統烏里布魯準備攜家人赴歐洲治療困擾他一段時間的末期疾病時，支持者多半以書信與他聯繫，也有人到他的辦公室拜訪。信中有人索取他的照片，擺在家中的顯要處。
body.en: Rubinzal's article records that, as the former provisional president prepared to travel to Europe with his family for treatment of a long-standing illness, supporters contacted him mostly by letter, and some were also received in his office. Some letter-writers asked for his photograph to place in a distinguished spot at home.

tratar una enfermedad terminal que lo aquejaba hace algún tiempo

body.zh-Hant: 阿方索·佩納（Afonso Augusto Moreira Pena）生於1847年11月30日，出生地在米納斯吉拉斯的聖巴爾巴拉。他10歲那年，即1857年，由父親帶到卡拉薩。
body.en: Afonso Augusto Moreira Pena was born on 30 November 1847 in Santa Bárbara, Minas Gerais. At the age of ten, in 1857, his father took him to the school at Caraça.

citations.quote: Afonso Augusto Moreira Pena (b. 30 November 1847; d. 14 June 1909)
Born in Santa Bárbara, Minas Gerais
nasceu em Santa Bárbara do Mato Dentro, em 30 de novembro de 1847.
Affonso Penna chega ao Caraça aos dez anos de idade, em 1857

heading.zh-Hant: 法學教育與帝國末期、共和初期的政治生涯
heading.en: Legal studies and imperial and early republican politics

body.zh-Hant: 他1866年轉往聖保羅，1870年10月23日取得法學文憑；1874年以自由黨身分當選省議員，1878年當選全國眾議員。1882年他以平民身分出任戰爭部長，次年轉任農業部長，1885年任司法部長，1888年進入民法典委員會，1890至1891年參加制憲會議。
body.en: He moved to São Paulo in 1866 and took his law diploma on 23 October 1870. Elected a provincial deputy for the Liberal Party in 1874, he was elected to the national chamber in 1878. In 1882 he became minister of war as a civilian, then minister of agriculture in 1883 and minister of justice in 1885, joined the Civil Code Commission in 1888 and sat in the Constitutional Convention in 1890–1891.

Diplomou-se em 23 de outubro de 1870,
Em 1874, eleito Deputado Provincial pelo Partido Liberal
Em 1878, foi eleito deputado para atuar na Corte

heading.zh-Hant: 米納斯吉拉斯州長、法學院與共和國銀行
heading.en: Governor of Minas Gerais, law school and Bank of the Republic

body.zh-Hant: 他1892年當選米納斯吉拉斯州長，據載任期為1892至1895年，任內將州首府由黑金城遷到貝洛奧里藏特。1892年11月13日在黑金城創辦的法學院由他出任首任院長，百科另記他1894至1898年擔任共和國銀行總裁。
body.en: Elected head of the state of Minas Gerais in 1892, he served as governor from 1892 to 1895 and moved the state capital from Ouro Prêto to Belo Horizonte. The law school created at Ouro Preto on 13 November 1892 elected him its first director, and the encyclopedia adds that he presided over the Bank of the Republic in 1894–1898.

citations.quote: Eleito para a Presidência do Estado em 1892
where he served as governor from 1892 to 1895
he moved the state capital from Ouro Prêto to Belo Horizonte
A criação da Escola ocorreu a 13 de novembro de 1892
na capital do Estado, Ouro Preto
elegendo-se Affonso Penna como seu primeiro Diretor
From 1894 to 1898, Pena was the president of the Bank of the Republic.

body.zh-Hant: 據《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》，他1903年當選巴西副總統，1906年當選總統，任職至去世為止。任內的建樹包括擴建全國鐵路網，並建立里約熱內盧與阿克里之間的電報連線。他於1909年6月14日在任上去世。
body.en: According to the Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture, he was elected vice president of Brazil in 1903 and president in 1906, an office he held until his death. His contributions included expanding the national railroad system and establishing telegraphic connections between Rio de Janeiro and Acre. He died on 14 June 1909 while in office.
